tickerText: [TENNIS] Friday at Almaty: Daniil Medvedev cruises past Sho Shimabukuro 6-2, 6-1, Karen Khachanov edges Tomas Machac 6-2, 4-6, 7-6(7) and Terence Atmane saves match points to beat Mattia Bellucci 6-7(4), 7-6(2), 7-6(5) ahead of quarterfinals; WTA Osaka sends Ann Li through over Lilli Tagger as Ningbo lines up Alexandrova–Fernandez, Shnaider–Jovic and Rybakina–Kudermetova • [SQUASH] PSA Gold Silicon Valley Open semifinals Friday at Squash Zone after Anahat Singh rallies past Salma Hany 4-11, 11-8, 4-11, 11-2, 11-5 for her maiden Gold semi on the heels of upsetting Nour El Sherbini; she faces Sivasangari Subramaniam while Diego Elias, Mohamed ElShorbagy and Mazen Hesham Zakaria headline the men's semis on SquashTV • [BADMINTON] YONEX French Open quarterfinals day at Arena Grand Paris with An Se-young vs Han Yue, Toma Junior Popov vs Alex Lanier and Kodai Naraoka vs Christo Popov on Court 1 after Ashmita Chaliha's career-best win over Akane Yamaguchi and Marvin Seidel/Thuc Phuong Nguyen stunned world No. 2 Jiang Zhen Bang/Wei Ya Xin • [PICKLEBALL] Hang Seng Bank Hong Kong Slam quarterfinals at Kai Tak Arena: Judit Castillo edged Kaitlyn Christian, Andie Dikosavljevic beat Chao Yi Wang 11-8, 11-6 and Ben Johns/Gabriel Tardio face Collin Johns/Len Yang in a rare all-Johns men's doubles quarterfinal as Hong Kit Wong meets Federico Staksrud in singles • [TABLE TENNIS] ITTF-ATTU Asian Championships in Tashkent: China beat South Korea 3-0 for a fourth straight men's team title while Japan rallied past China 3-2 for women's gold; Friday's slate runs mixed doubles from quarterfinals through the 19:30 final plus ongoing singles and doubles at Olympic Town

newsItems.title: Johns Brothers Face Off
newsItems.excerpt: Hong Kong Slam quarterfinals set a rare men's doubles bro-down as Ben Johns and Gabriel Tardio meet Collin Johns and Len Yang, while Judit Castillo beat Kaitlyn Christian and Andie Dikosavljevic topped Chao Yi Wang 11-8, 11-6 at Kai Tak.

newsItems.title: Anahat Into Gold Semis
newsItems.excerpt: Anahat Singh fought back from 2-1 down to beat Salma Hany 4-11, 11-8, 4-11, 11-2, 11-5 at the Silicon Valley Open, reaching her first PSA Gold semifinal a day after stunning Nour El Sherbini; she next plays Sivasangari Subramaniam.

newsItems.title: Medvedev Rolls in Almaty
newsItems.excerpt: Top seed Daniil Medvedev beat Sho Shimabukuro 6-2, 6-1 in Almaty round of 16 action as Karen Khachanov outlasted Tomas Machac 6-2, 4-6, 7-6(7) and Terence Atmane saved match points to defeat Mattia Bellucci 6-7(4), 7-6(2), 7-6(5).

newsItems.title: French Open Quarterfinal Day
newsItems.excerpt: The YONEX French Open moves into quarterfinals at Arena Grand Paris with An Se-young vs Han Yue and an all-French Popov–Lanier singles clash, following Ashmita Chaliha's upset of Akane Yamaguchi and Seidel/Nguyen's win over Jiang/Wei.
